title: Weighted Sum of a Tree
summary: A parent array defines a tree rooted at zero. Root depth is one and height is the maximum depth. Give node i weight nums[i]*(height-depth[i]+1), and return the sum of all node weights.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 nodes; parent[0]=-1 and remaining parents valid; input is a rooted tree; values1..10^6.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
